title: Turn a planner's request into solve parameters
heading: Choose the Tolerance in Money, Then Set Both
cases: money in dollars becomes an absolute tolerance in $k, a percent becomes a fraction, minutes become a time limit
with no share given the relative tolerance is set to 0, never left to the solver's default
with no amount given the absolute tolerance stays unset rather than 0
a node budget replaces the time limit, since a repeatable run cannot depend on the clock
a fractional number of minutes is kept, not rounded down
